quote_original: So Israel owes his uniqueness to his covenant marriage.
context_before: If you are a man, don�t be ashamed of speaking of this being in you as feminine, for it is more you than what you see reflected in the mirror. Your awareness is the bride of the Lord. She can’t conceive without the embrace and seed of her husband.
context_after: Christ is formed from that union and a new state is born. Jacob (desire) becomes Israel (fulfillment) when David reveals himself as your son.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Forming Of Christ In You (1969-06-23).

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: The Forming Of Christ In You
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-06-23 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: What would you see if it were true?
context_before: This is the most practical thing you would ever hear. Test your Self, he who is forming Christ in you, by conceiving a scene which would imply the fulfillment of your dream.
context_after: What would you hear? What would you do? Now, begin to look, hear, and do it all in your imagination; and when you go to bed tonight, sleep as though it had already come to pass.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Forming Of Christ In You (1969-06-23).

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: The Forming Of Christ In You
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-06-23 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: He can appear in many forms.
context_before: Always bear in mind that God is a protean being.
context_after: A friend and father of five children came to see me the other day. One of his little girls has a pet rabbit, a doe, who was sick. She asked her father to ask me to pray for it. This I did. The following week the vet treated the rabbit and it is now home and well.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Forming Of Christ In You (1969-06-23).

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: The Forming Of Christ In You
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-06-23 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Now, who do you think wore the form?
context_before: my people.� The vision was so real the father said to himself: “This must be �Midsummer Night�s Dream�, but I am seeing a rabbit instead of a donkey.”
context_after: God. He sends himself in everyone that he sends, and the one sent is one with the sender. He too then is protean, and can assume any shape or form. My friend asked for help and received it, and is now encouraged to believe all the more.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Forming Of Christ In You (1969-06-23).

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: The Forming Of Christ In You
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-06-23 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: This is the story of scripture.
context_before: This is how God speaks to all to encourage faith, for by faith all things are made and faith is simply loyalty to unseen reality. If you imagine a state, it is unseen by others, but if you assume it is true, your husband – who is a god of truth – will give it to you. He so loved you he became you, and when you imagine, he imagines. Then one day the fusion will be complete and then there will no longer be you and God: you will know yourself to be God, who actually became you that you might become God.
context_after: Now, God does not become this body of flesh. It is Esau – the hairy outer form – he hates. He is in love with Jacob – the human imagination – who is t
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Forming Of Christ In You (1969-06-23).

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: The Forming Of Christ In You
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-06-23 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: That is the part I have played most of the time.
context_before: So, the Risen Lord can appear as the Spirit of Holiness or the Spirit of Love. When my Father fused himself with me he appeared as the Spirit of Love, but he sent me wearing the form of power.
context_after: Martha, who has now gone from this sphere, saw me as power. That, too, was done for a purpose, so that Martha would know the power of truth. But on this level of my being I am just a normal man with the human weaknesses of any outer man. Money doesn’t give you power. They just buried a man who possessed millions. He left behind $500 million, and could not take one million of it with him. He is now probably the richest spirit in the graveyard.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Forming Of Christ In You (1969-06-23).

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: The Forming Of Christ In You
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-06-23 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: God himself is the suffering servant.
context_before: Isaiah was not writing about a man of flesh, but was telling an eternal, immortal story.
context_after: He so loves you, he will not alter your imagination. If you imagine some horrible thing he will fulfill it, and because you have to experience all that you imagine he will suffer with you. Always allowing you to imagine, be it wisely or unwisely, he fulfills it with you. That is your suffering servant. But in the end, having gone through hell with you – the one he loves most – he rejoices, for when he comes out he and his emanation are one. This story makes no sense if seen only on the page of a book. It must be experienced to be understood.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Forming Of Christ In You (1969-06-23).

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: The Forming Of Christ In You
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-06-23 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: I am telling you the truth.
context_before: until the son of God bears witness to this union, man leaves this world to enter another, to marry and continue the struggle, just as it is done here.
context_after: I take the Bible and let my intuition play upon it, then the meaning comes to the surface. Scripture will last forever in the form in which it is written because of its simplicity. But its revelations will not come unless you dig for the words� deeper meaning.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Forming Of Christ In You (1969-06-23).

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: The Forming Of Christ In You
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-06-23 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Then you too will decree to David: “Thou art my son.
context_before: Only when you find the Christ which was formed in you will you know who you really are.
context_after: Today I have begotten thee.” No one has ever seen God, but the son who is in the bosom of the Father, he has made him known. When Christ appears it is because he has been formed in you, by you, because by then you have been born – not of blood, or of the will of the flesh, or of the will of man – but of God. You will know you are Spirit and your son is Spirit, and together you form the Lord Jesus Christ.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Forming Of Christ In You (1969-06-23).

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: The Forming Of Christ In You
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-06-23 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Then their married state will be over.
context_before: There isn’t one nth part of one per cent who will accept this, but I will not change it one iota because I know the day will come when everyone will experience it.
context_after: They will know they have only one husband, who is their very self. This coming of marriage is your redeeming power, for your husband – the God of the whole earth – is your redeemer. He has been so long with you, yet you have not seen him; but I tell you, when you see me you have seen the Father.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Forming Of Christ In You (1969-06-23).
